description: This file defines a PHP class CURLStringFile that extends CURLFile to handle string data uploads via cURL. It includes conditional class definition based on PHP version and cURL extension availability.

classes.name: CURLStringFile
classes.description: A subclass of CURLFile that enables uploading string data with cURL by encoding it and setting it as a data URI.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with string data, encoding it in base64 and passing it to the parent constructor.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Allows setting properties; specifically allows updating the 'data' property with validation and re-encoding.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Returns a reference to a property value.
